errors.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 address, e.g. 192.168.1.50
errors.invalid_wifi: The heater could not join the WiFi network. Check the network name and password, and that it is a 2.4 GHz network.
errors.write_without_response: This heater only accepts Bluetooth writes Homey does not support. Use "Manual setup" instead (provision the heater from a computer).
errors.heater_not_found: Heater not found over Bluetooth. Make sure the blue LED is blinking and that the heater is close to Homey.
errors.unauthorized: The heater rejected the token. Repair the device and set it up again over Bluetooth.
errors.http: The heater responded with an error (HTTP __status__). Try power cycling the heater, or repair the device.
errors.no_answer: No answer from the heater at __ip__ (__message__).
errors.not_found_on_network: The heater was not found on the network. Check that it is powered on, or set it up again over Bluetooth.
errors.unreachable: The heater is unreachable. Homey will keep trying, and search the network for a new IP address.
errors.not_confirmed: The heater did not confirm the new temperature
errors.write_timeout: The heater at __ip__ did not respond in time. Check that it is powered on and has WiFi, then try again.
errors.invalid_password_length: The WiFi password must be 8–63 characters (or 64 hex characters). Leave it empty for an open network.

pair.title: Set up Adax heater
pair.intro: The heater is set up locally. It will be removed from the Adax app, and the Adax app will no longer control it.
pair.step_reset: Reset the heater: press + and OK until the display shows "Reset".
pair.step_ble: Then press and hold OK until the blue LED starts blinking.
pair.step_near: Keep the heater (or its thermostat) close to Homey – Bluetooth range is short.
pair.step_dhcp: Tip: give the heater a fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) in your router afterwards.
pair.no_heaters: No Adax heaters found. Make sure the blue LED is blinking, and search again.
pair.manual_intro: Use this if the heater has already been provisioned with a token, e.g. from a computer.

progress.connecting: Connecting to the heater over Bluetooth…
progress.waiting: Waiting for the heater to join WiFi (this can take a minute)…
progress.verifying: Checking that the heater answers on the network…

pair.repair_intro: Choose how to reconnect the heater.
pair.rediscover: Search the network for the heater
pair.rediscover_intro: Use this if the heater has got a new IP address.
pair.reprovision_intro: Creates a new token. Reset the heater first (see the setup instructions).
